display_name: Naucratius, brother of Basil the Great

names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 8 iunie, «Sfântul Cuvios Navcratie».

death.note: Second son of `basil-the-elder`, who died in 350, and of `emilia-mother-of-basil-the-great`, who died in 375, and brother of `basil-the-great`, born 330 and dead 379, all as this corpus records them; the life this folder cites has him die before his mother. No year is printed for him.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).
